notice.title: Semester Examination Schedule Released
notice.description: The Semester End Examination timetable has been published. Students are advised to check the schedule and prepare accordingly. Examinations will commence from 15 June 2026.

notice.title: Campus Placement Drive by TechNova Solutions
notice.description: TechNova Solutions will conduct a campus recruitment drive on 20 June 2026. Eligible students should register through the Training and Placement Cell before the deadline.

notice.title: Library Maintenance Notice
notice.description: The central library will remain closed on 12 June 2026 due to scheduled maintenance and software upgrades. Students are requested to return borrowed books beforehand.

notice.title: Annual Sports Meet Registration Open
notice.description: Registrations for the Annual Sports Meet are now open. Interested students can register for various indoor and outdoor sports events through their department coordinators.

notice.title: Workshop on Data Science and Visualization
notice.description: The Department of Computer Science is organizing a one-day workshop on Data Science and Visualization. Students interested in analytics and machine learning are encouraged to participate.
